title: Umbel event, version 3
description: One line of state/spaces/<space>/events.jsonl: a projection of one journal entry. Version 3 is version 2 with a provenance envelope version 3 (phase 5 section 2.4; a new envelope version needs a new event version, D36). Every other field keeps version 2's meaning, the stored cursor included: a stored line holds positions, and only the cursor strings handed to callers that are not process are sealed (cursor version 1, section 9.3). Lines written as versions 0 to 2 stay as written; a consumer accepts all four.

cursor.description: The cursor that resumes after this event.

record.description: The record the command named in result.metadata["dev.umbel/record"], or null.

changes.description: The store revisions this call wrote. Other processes may write between fromRev and toRev, so toRev - fromRev + 1 can exceed count. store names the store when it is not the document store.

store.description: memory, or absent for the document store.
